attachments.origin_landmark: straight head: AIIS; reflected head: groove superior to acetabular rim
attachments.insertion_landmark: base of patella, via quadriceps tendon -> patellar ligament -> tibial tuberosity

actions: flexes hip (only quadriceps head crossing the hip joint)

functional_compartments.name: Straight (anterior) head

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: central aponeurosis endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Proximal of two motor-point concentrations. Reported by the source for the muscle as a whole; this atlas's functional compartments are not separately mapped there, so the same zone is recorded on each.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part III -- Proximal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(5):240 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17050240 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites

motor_endplate_zones.notes: Distal of two motor-point concentrations. The clinic's own practice is to inject roughly 2 cm proximal and 2 cm distal to mid-thigh on the anterior midline, at maximum muscle thickness. Reported by the source for the muscle as a whole; this atlas's functional compartments are not separately mapped there, so the same zone is recorded on each.

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse at the proximal third of the anterior thigh, on the midline. For injection, about 2 cm proximal and 2 cm distal to mid-thigh on the anterior midline.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Superficial to vastus intermedius, which lies on the femoral cortex.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Superficial and oval-shaped, over the deeper vastus intermedius.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: The stiff knee gait pattern is the usual indication. Injection has been shown to increase maximal muscle lengthening and stretch capacity during gait in spastic hemiparesis.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al.
